test_faulty_rpc_backend_options: test the faulty RPC backend options including worker threads, fail sends, and message configurations
test_custom_faulty_messages: test configuring custom faulty messages to fail specific RPC message types like RREF_FORK_REQUEST
test_remote_message_dropped: test that rpc.remote calls fail with RuntimeError when PYTHON_REMOTE_CALL or SCRIPT_REMOTE_CALL messages are dropped
test_remote_message_delay_timeout: test that delayed RPC messages trigger timeout errors on rpc.remote and rpc.rpc_sync calls
test_rpc_timeout_behavior: test rpc.rpc_sync and rpc.rpc_async timeout behavior with custom and default timeout settings
